_about: One review record per item the Pachislop port wrote (docs/specs/S84-title-library.md R22, §6.7.4): `kind` (look, template, color_scheme: a look and a template may share an id), verdict match, close, tuned (needs an overrides.json entry of that kind and id) or differs; every verdict but match needs a note. The review sheets come from `title-library review-sheet`.
